<title>Jairo Lopez — Electrical Pre-Apprentice</title>

<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    background: #F0EBE3;
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 32px 16px;
    color: #1A1A1A;
  }
  .page {
    max-width: 680px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* ── HEADER CARD ── */
  .hero {
    background: #1F4E79;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 32px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    right: -40px; top: -40px;
    width: 200px; height: 200px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .hero-photo {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .hero-info { flex: 1; }
  .hero-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    color: #fff;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #BDD7EE;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .badge {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  .badge-green  { background: #E2EFDA; color: #375623; }
  .badge-blue   { background: #D6E4F0; color: #1F4E79; }
  .badge-teal   { background: #E1F5EE; color: #085041; }
  .badge-orange { background: #FCE4D6; color: #833C00; }

  /* ── CARDS ── */
  .card {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 0.5px solid #E0E0E0;
    padding: 20px 24px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .card-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #888;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  /* ── PROFILE ── */
  .profile-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: #444;
  }

  /* ── SKILLS ── */
  .skills-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .skill-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #444;
  }
  .skill-dot {
    width: 7px; height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #1D9E75;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ── CERTIFICATIONS ── */
  .cert-list { list-style: none; }
  .cert-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 9px 0;
    border-bottom: 0.5px solid #F0F0F0;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #333;
  }
  .cert-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .cert-check {
    width: 22px; height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #E2EFDA;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .cert-check svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: #375623; }

  /* ── EXPERIENCE ── */
  .exp-item { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .exp-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .exp-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .exp-company { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #1F4E79; }
  .exp-date { font-size: 12px; color: #888; }
  .exp-role { font-size: 12px; color: #888; margin-bottom: 6px; font-style: italic; }
  .exp-bullets { list-style: none; }
  .exp-bullets li {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #555;
    padding: 2px 0 2px 16px;
    position: relative;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  .exp-bullets li::before {
    content: '·';
    position: absolute;
    left: 4px;
    color: #2E75B6;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  /* ── EDUCATION ── */
  .edu-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .edu-school { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #1F4E79; }
  .edu-detail { font-size: 13px; color: #888; margin-top: 3px; }

  /* ── WORK PHOTOS ── */
  .photos-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .photo-slot {
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #F5F5F5;
    border: 1.5px dashed #D0D0D0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #AAA;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8px;
  }

  /* ── CONTACT BUTTON ── */
  .contact-section {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 0.5px solid #E0E0E0;
    padding: 24px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .contact-section p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #888;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .contact-btn {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 15px;
    background: #1F4E79;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .contact-btn:hover { background: #2E75B6; }
  .contact-btn.secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: #1F4E79;
    border: 1px solid #1F4E79;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 11px;
  }
  .contact-btn.secondary:hover { background: #D6E4F0; }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  .footer {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px 0 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #AAA;
    border-top: 0.5px solid #E0E0E0;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .footer strong { color: #2E75B6; }

  /* ── DIVIDER ── */
  .divider {
    height: 0.5px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    margin: 12px 0;
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .hero { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
    .badges { justify-content: center; }
    .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .photos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  }
</style>
</head>
